name: mission CSI
author: WhaleDP
description: Go above the robot portal as the wave at 40% between the portal and platform and then hold to the ceiling. Move down at 43% after passing the UFO portal and then navigate through the following gameplay as the wave until 45% where you can go above the ship portal between the portal and structure, drop down a bit and then hold to the ceiling. Drop down shortly before the spike at 47% and then navigate through the gameplay as the wave while avoiding all of the portals until 53% where you can hold to the ceiling after getting the .5x speed portal. Hold to the ceiling until the end from there.
